journey: Retention: ephemeral box (no lingering job data) + durable occupancy record

narrative.step: acquires a runner → a real box with a disk
closes it → teardown destroys the box and its disk
the box is GONE — its lease no longer reads as held (no lingering compute/data)
narrative.assertion: after teardown the box is not HELD (status=200, state=released) — ephemeral, no lingering job data

narrative.step: but the durable occupancy record PERSISTS the box — usage-history still resolves
narrative.assertion: GET /v1/usage/history → 200 after teardown (the billing record outlives the ephemeral box); records residual

artifact.retentionWindow: owner-gated (policy — tax/VAT vs Art.17 tension unresolved)
